text: The Building (Amendment) Act 2016 is a legislative measure passed by the National Parliament of Papua New Guinea to modernize and streamline building regulations. It serves as a legislative and institutional pipeline to incorporate building code advances into PNG's legal framework, addressing public safety, urban development, and energy performance considerations. The Act was passed and certified in 2016, with the Office of Legislative Counsel facilitating the consolidation and public access to updated laws through the Pacific Islands Legal Information Institute.
